story_contract.locked_title: Auditing and rectifying reasoning, ranking, and grounding biases in agentic scientific discovery
story_contract.conflict_hook: Multi-agent large language model systems combine candidate ideation, pairwise Bradley-Terry-Luce tournaments, and literature synthesis, yet scaling test-time chain-of-thought fails to self-correct positional preference inversions, parametric citation confabulations, and deliberative self-pruning.
story_contract.protagonist: STAR-Audit, a six-dimension external-truth audit and four-module zero-call algorithmic rectification framework
story_contract.significance: Converts uncalibrated test-time reasoning spin into verifiable, bias-corrected, and compute-efficient multi-agent scientific discovery without model retraining or extra inference calls.

journal_style_contract.target_journal: Nature Communications (Special Collection: Agentic AI Systems)
